name: artarch-studio
description: Create and edit AI images, videos, ads, and visual stories in ArtArch Studio.

interface.shortDescription: Create AI ads, images, edits, and short films
interface.longDescription: Use ArtArch as an AI creative studio for commercial advertising, image generation and cleanup, object or person removal, storyboards, themed short films, and video production. Business-level MCP tools build the supporting canvas while persistence and collaboration stay internal.
defaultPrompt: Create a 15-second premium perfume commercial, including the hero visual, storyboard, and final video.
Remove the passersby from this photo while preserving the subject, composition, and background naturally.
Create a creative short film themed "Eastern Future"; start with the visual direction and storyboard.
